The animal has reddish-brown fur on its back and head, with a distinct white/cream underbelly and throat. Its body is elongated and slender, stretching horizontally to the right. The head features a pointed snout, small dark eye, and rounded ear. The background is a soft-focus mix of grey rocks and green vegetation.
